lede: Only one story crossed feeds on Monday, September 14: Hanuman Ansh, the devotional drama pulling Indian search traffic, surfaced on Google Trends and Wikipedia at the same time. Everywhere else the web split into its usual lanes. On GitHub, a tiny C project called colibri gathered 868 stars in a single day to lead trending, and on Hacker News a claim that Fable 5.1 cracked a 370-year-old cipher drew 673 points and 291 comments. A quiet, scattered day, pulse reading 37 out of 100.
